name: Aiman Zulkifli
bio: Aiman's fascination with motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to the Sepang International Circuit. He studied engineering and quickly discovered a talent for optimizing team performance and logistics. After graduation, Aiman honed his skills at a small Formula 4 team, where he streamlined operations and helped them achieve unexpected success. He believes in empowering every team member to contribute their best work and is known for his innovative solutions to complex logistical challenges. Aiman is eager to bring his blend of technical knowledge and managerial prowess to a top-tier team, helping them achieve championship glory. His forward-thinking approach and dedication to fostering a collaborative environment make him a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a lean, athletic build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistics flowcharts.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings while walking, believing it sparks more creative ideas.
